Koffing

Poison

Kanto · Generation 1

Koffing is a Poison-type Poison Gas Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 1 kg. It evolves into Weezing. Its highest base stat is Defense (95), with a base stat total of 340.
